notes.title: ver1.1.7e released!!!
notes.content:
To the Employer. Thank you for your contributions to our company.
This update includes the following changes and fixes.

[h2]Nightmare enhancements[/h2]
Other employees reported that the nightmare was different from usual. For more information, try the nightmare yourself.

[h3]Some minor adjustments to the UI[/h3]
Removed the X-close button when reporting, so you can now click outside the category area to close it.

[h3]Some anomaly renaming[/h3]
In the past, it was often the case that a report was incorrectly made due to the name of the anomaly. The name “lighting anomaly” was changed to “change in brightness” and “change in texture/stain” was changed to “change in texture/stain.

[h3]Eradication of specific anomalies[/h3]
Thanks to our company's efforts, the anomaly of objects swapping (not replacing) each other has been eradicated. We hope this will reduce the number of wrong reports from employers.

[h3]Synchronized lighting and brightness[/h3]
The light emission did not change when the brightness changed, but from this version, the degree of light emission changes depending on the brightness.

[h3]Changes in lighting[/h3]
The lighting at my workplace has been updated, so it may look a little different than before. However, it will not affect the work.
